faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Collie (Rough)?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 50-75 lb (23-34 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a adult Collie (Rough)?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights MDR1 drug sensitivity; Collie eye anomaly; Dermatomyositis risk. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Collie (Rough) at this stage?
faqs.answer: Every 30 days is a practical adult Collie (Rough) default unless your veterinarian sets a tighter plan.
